name: xoga750-fix2-gpc-trade-id-counter-dev
description: DEV ONLY. Gives business unit GPC a trade id counter, so a GPC Trade run gets TR-FY-2026-54984 and up like old Opera instead of the fallback TRN000001. Today GPC has no row in oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria (9 of 27 BUs have one), reserveTradeIds throws 'No sequence row found' and assign-trade-ids.js falls back to TRN000001. Old Opera took the highest existing suffix of the BU plus 1; its first id on 25-Nov was 54984, so the counter starts at 54983. Two rows are added, copied from the OGP rows (the template BU) so the shape is the one the UI writes: a tradeId format row and a sequence row whose parent_uuid points at it. Only businessUnit is replaced in the copied JSON and last_sequence_id is set. The source SELECTs return no row when GPC already has a sequence row, which stops the load (expect source 1). Read the preview rows (the step csv files in the zip) before --apply: the JSON copied from OGP must look right for GPC.

source.sql: SELECT CAST(md5('xoga750-gpc-tradeid-format') AS uuid) AS uuid, f.tenant_id, f.name, f.number_of_digits, f.reference_format, f.reset_value, f.transaction_reference_description, f.transaction_status, f.transaction_type, f.periodicity, f.split_sequence, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.transaction_sequence_criteria) = 'object' THEN jsonb_set(f.transaction_sequence_criteria, '{businessUnit}', to_jsonb(CAST(:bu AS text)))::text ELSE f.transaction_sequence_criteria::text END AS transaction_sequence_criteria, f.created_timestamp FROM opera.oga_configservice_transactionidformatmaster f WHERE f.tenant_id = :tenant AND f.transaction_type = 'tradeId' AND f.uuid::text IN (SELECT t.parent_uuid FROM opera.oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria t WHERE t.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(t.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit') = upper(:templateBu)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria g WHERE g.tenant_id = :tenant AND g.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit' ILIKE :bu)

SELECT CAST(md5('xoga750-gpc-tradeid-sequence') AS uuid) AS uuid, s.tenant_id, CAST(CAST(md5('xoga750-gpc-tradeid-format') AS uuid) AS text) AS parent_uuid, s.start_value, s.end_value, CAST(:lastId AS integer) AS last_sequence_id, s.sequence_type, jsonb_set(s.sequence_criteria, '{businessUnit}', to_jsonb(CAST(:bu AS text)))::text AS sequence_criteria FROM opera.oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(s.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit') = upper(:templateBu) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria g WHERE g.tenant_id = :tenant AND g.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit' ILIKE :bu)
